description: Quotes; purchase orders; new customer and new ship-to checks; hydrogen peroxide end-use statements; supplier purchase orders
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Bulk loads are scheduled 3 to 5 days ahead, so a 2-day stop delays but does not break supply; verification failures can hand an explosive precursor to the wrong party (safety Severe); losing a producer's distribution agreement is the worst business outcome
manual_workaround: Take orders by phone from known buyers only; read back the ship-to against the last delivered address; no new customers or new ship-to addresses until email and the workbook are back
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner (single point of failure); home office

business_process: Shipment arrangement and hazmat shipping papers
description: Confirm hazard class from the SDS; prepare the BOL with the hazmat description, ERI number, and shipper's certification; book the carrier; send the supplier the pickup authorization
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Pickups are booked at supplier docks; a missed day causes carrier detention charges and can leave a customer's water treatment or sanitation short; a wrong BOL or a forged pickup authorization is a direct HMR and safety failure; pickup authorizations change during the day, so RPO is 4 hours
manual_workaround: Phone the supplier's shipping office from the phone's contact list to confirm or hold each scheduled pickup; hand-write a BOL from the printed product description sheet and send it from a clean device; postpone non-urgent loads
dependent_third_parties: Suppliers' shipping offices; carriers; ERI provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner (only person who can release a load)

business_process: In-transit support and emergency response information
description: Answer calls from carriers, supplier shipping offices, consignees, and the ERI provider about loads on the road; confirm delivery
process_owner: Owner (ERI provider covers the 24-hour emergency line)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The emergency number must be monitored at all times while hazmat is in transportation (172.604(a)(1)); the ERI provider meets that, but it may need the owner for shipment details within hours; a diverted or stuck load must be acted on the same morning
manual_workaround: ERI provider answers emergency calls 24 hours a day; the printed list of loads in transit and carrier dispatch numbers lets the owner work from any phone
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner (single point of failure for non-emergency calls)

description: Invoices; customer ACH receipts; wires and ACH to suppliers; bank-detail changes
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Receipts of about $180,000 a year: one diverted customer payment or misdirected supplier wire can exceed $15,000, so integrity matters more than speed; suppliers give 30-day terms
manual_workaround: Pay suppliers only to bank details already on file; confirm any change by calling a known number; collect by check if the accounting SaaS is down
dependent_third_parties: Accounting SaaS vendor; bank; outside accountant

description: BOL copies (2-year retention); training records; registration certificates; the hazmat security plan; SDS library; driver data
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: DOT can ask for records at reasonable times and locations; no daily deadline. An RPO of 24 hours is not supported today because email and files have no backup
manual_workaround: Ask suppliers and carriers for copies of signed BOLs; reprint certificates from the PHMSA and training provider portals
dependent_third_parties: Email and file suite provider; training provider
